Exact differentiation and resultant elimination rule out nonsymmetric stationary points in the strict interior; the symmetry line has its unique maximum at \(q=2/3\), and the two simplex-edge families have squared correlation at most \(1/9\). The boundary limits are therefore below \(64/361\). The inspected symbolic verifier independently reconstructs the moments, resultant, edge formulas, uniform value, and the published benchmark; it is corroboration rather than the proof.
